detail: Recompute three harness instruments from rows-*.jsonl with own throwaway code BEFORE reading their implementation. Zero inference requests, no network, no git. Instrument A=request_ledger count/gate, B=calibrated projection (exit 8), C=client.STOP_REASONS.

My count first: 14 files, 1101 rows, kinds turn=801 tool-followup=68 unmarked=232. My rule (reached the wire = has prompt_tokens OR an HTTP-status error): 1099 requests, excluding 2 rows that record pre-flight failures with no tokens and no HTTP status (rows-live-2026-10-26.jsonl: 'setup: TypeError: Ledger.__init__()...', 'target_not_reached P1=385'). Their rule counts every unmarked row as assumed_billed, so it counts those 2. Delta -2 (0.18%); direction inflates spend, i.e. conservative for the gate. 12 HTTP-400 rows (unit C0-BASELINE, null tokens) correctly counted by both rules: a rejected request still took a wire slot. 23 checkpoint rows are genuine calls (21 kind=turn, 2 tool-followup, own prompt/completion tokens). Exclusion markers billed / followup_suppressed / served_from fire on 0 rows; the real near-miss markers are billed_round=False and prompt_served=1 (the same 4 rows) whose completions are 288/279/405/58 tokens, so counting them is right.

Induced all four ledger codes. 0: 'within budget: 1101 <= 4320 (3219 left)'. 4: 'OVER BUDGET: spent=1101 + would_spend=3220 = 4321 > cap=4320 - reserve=0 = 4320 (over by 1)' exit=4. 5: /tmp/bad-rows.jsonl line 2 -> 'row file error: ... unparseable row: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' + 'nothing counted: an unreadable row file makes the total unknowable' exit=5. 3: 'usage error: no row files matched /tmp/nomatch-*.jsonl' exit=3.

My recompute of per-mode walls (wall_ms/1000 else latency_s, error rows dropped, intervals linear-interpolated): off/absent n=960 mean 27.5 p50 2.9 p90 38.1 ratio 0.0338; on/auto n=9 mean 286.5 p50 218.2 p90 682.7 ratio 0.0349; live cell-pointer-stable n=6 mean 190.9 p50 129.1 p90 427.7 ratio 0.0288. Every figure matches PROJECTION.json to 4 dp -> delta 0. 0.03 s/token is the rounded published figure (BUDGET-SCHEDULE.md:24 lists 0.0338 off / 0.0288 live / 0.0349 on/auto); 0.03 x a nominal 2000-token turn = 60 s = defaults.projected_turn_wall_s. Residual spread says the aggregate hides a bimodal distribution: on/auto per-ROW ratio clusters at 0.0281-0.0290 (n=6) and 0.0416-0.0521 (n=3), p90/p50 = 1.52x; off p50 0.0343, p90 0.0420, max 2.4500.

G2 boundary is exact at +-1 s: turns=60 projected=3600 accepts at --max-wall 3600 and 3601, refuses at 3599 (ok=not(projected>max_wall)). Defect still reachable by flag: --projected-turn-wall 180 -> projected 10800 (identical to the old worst case 60x180) and refused; --turn-wall-cap 180 alone leaves projected 3600 accepted (cap only printed as worst case); --projected-from live p90 427.7 -> projected 25662 refused. Default is mode-blind: --projected-from has default None and no code passes it, so a thinking-auto cell is admitted on the 60 s default while its own measured p50 is 218.2 s/turn (3.6x) and p90 682.7 s (11.4x).

Induced 10/10 vocabulary members through client.derive_stop_reason with my own fake inputs: stop<-finish='stop'; length<-finish='length'; tool_calls<-finish='tool_calls'; content_filter<-finish='content_filter'; turn_wall_cap<-error_code; runaway_turn<-error_code; http_error<-error_code; stream_error<-error_code; empty_response<-no finish + no content; unknown<-no finish + content. No finish reason that is unmappable ('weird') -> unknown. Adversarial: (i) finish='length' with completion_tokens=5 < max_tokens=4096 -> 'length' (server wins, no token corroboration); (ii) no finish chunk with completion_tokens=128 >= max_tokens=128 -> 'length' (rule 3, recovers the 128 case); (iii) finish='tool_calls' -> 'tool_calls'; (iii-b) a tool call whose stream ends with NO finish chunk and no text content -> 'empty_response' (Hole: it is not a tool call to the vocabulary).

group by stop_reason over the corpus returns {None: 1101} -- 0 of 1101 rows carry a stop_reason field (677 carry finish_reason/max_tokens). The seven cap-exhausted arm-checks are therefore NOT identifiable today by group by stop_reason; only a future run records the word. Analogous population in the measure corpus: 99 stage-1 rows, content empty, completion_tokens=128, none carrying max_tokens. Re-deriving them offline WITH the frozen manifest cap (max_tokens=128) labels all 99 'length'; re-deriving from the row as-is labels all 99 'empty_response'. So the vocabulary could have labelled the old rows correctly only if the cap had been carried in the row. runaway_turn has no producer: nothing writes error='runaway_turn' and client.py:698 calls derive_stop_reason without error_code, so 0 rows can ever carry it.

Re-ran the G2 boundary on the current bytes: 3601 -> (3600, ACCEPT), 3600 -> (3600, ACCEPT), 3599 -> (3600, REFUSE), --projected-turn-wall 180 -> (10800, REFUSE) - identical, so the B verdict stands; recorded as sha drift in the handoff and docs rather than claiming the file unchanged.

Verdicts: A request_ledger pass (1099 vs 1101 requests, delta -2, conservative; exit 0/3/4/5 induced). B projection partial (all per-mode walls and ratios match PROJECTION.json at delta 0; boundary exact at +-1 s; but the default multiplier is a mode-blind 60 s and --projected-turn-wall 180 restores the old 10800 s worst case). C stop reasons partial (10/10 inducible; runaway_turn unreachable, tool-call-without-finish-chunk labelled empty_response, 0/1101 historical rows carry stop_reason). overall partial. Zero inference requests, 25 tool calls of 36. Four write paths created; no other file touched.
